footer.disclaimer: UNOFA is a student project. U has no real-world value.

auth.heroBody: A colour-matching card game for friends in the same room. You bet U, play money worth nothing outside the game.
auth.lockedFor: Too many tries. Try again in {{min}} min.
auth.termsAgain: The disclaimer changed. I have read the new version.
auth.terms: I have read the disclaimer and understand U is not money.
auth.reloginBody: Your session expired. Sign in to keep playing as {{name}}.

lobby.title: Find a table
lobby.stakeNote: Everyone bets this when the host deals. You can change it in the room.
lobby.stakeTooHigh: Your balance is below this stake.

room.cantAfford: Your balance is below the stake.
room.betNote: The stake is taken when the round starts. Disconnecting does not refund it.
room.leaveForfeit: A round is running. Leaving forfeits your stake.
room.kicked: The host removed you from this room

table.yourTurnDrew: Play the card you drew, or pass
table.catchNow: {{name}} forgot to call UNO. Catch them!
table.challengeBody: Accept: draw 4 and lose your turn. Challenge: if they held a card of the old colour, they draw 4 instead. If not, you draw 6.
table.burnBody: Everyone left. The pot goes to the house:
table.leaveBody: Leaving counts as forfeit. Your stake stays in the pot.
table.goneBody: It ended or was cancelled while you were away.
table.offline: No connection. Your move was not sent.
table.replaced: This account opened the game somewhere else.

account.confirmSendBody: Transfers cannot be undone. Limit: 1,000U per 24 hours.

loan.title: Borrow U
loan.lede: One loan at a time. Interest is fixed when you borrow.
loan.previewLate: Late: +{{rate}} every 24 hours, up to {{cap}}. Seized after {{days}} late days.
loan.note: Repaying early still costs the full-term interest.
loan.confirmBorrowBody: If you do not repay, the debt grows until it reaches {{cap}}, then it is seized from your balance.
loan.overdueBanner: Overdue: +5% every 24 hours. {{n}} days late so far.

rules.title: How to play
rules.lede: Empty your hand first. The winner takes the pot.
rules.match: Play a card with the same colour or the same number as the top card. Wild cards go on anything. Every colour has its own shape, so you never have to tell colours apart.
rules.draw: Cannot play? Draw one card. If it fits you may play it, otherwise pass.

skip.name: Skip
skip.body: The next player loses their turn.

reverse.name: Reverse
reverse.body: Turn order flips. With two players you go again.

draw2.name: Draw two
draw2.body: The next player draws 2 and loses their turn.

wild.name: Wild
wild.body: Pick the colour for the next turn.

wild4.name: Wild +4
wild4.body: Pick a colour. The next player draws 4 and loses their turn, unless they challenge.

rules.uno: Down to one card? Press UNO. Forget, and anyone can catch you before the next player moves. Then you draw 2.
rules.timer: Each turn lasts 20 seconds. Run out and you draw 1 and lose the turn.
rules.money: Everyone at the table bets the same stake. The winner takes the whole pot. U is play money and is worth nothing outside UNOFA.

keys.color: Pick a colour after a wild

rules.keysNote: Letter keys only work while focus is inside the table.
